Item.start/comma.end/last syntactic token.end controls and Parse phase witnesses separate from Lex/Name/source copy; new stack and large flat Drop inputs are defined.

Actual capacity correction, old/new peaks, every allocation failure, retained owners and cleanup are covered by new P4 entry inputs. Shared DB means retained-owner accounting across native threads, not concurrent allocation-race evidence.
Full source/every arena entry/kind/payload/span/link/marker/error/complete equality; generated trivia only relocates authored expectations.
Exact semantic case and continuation are exclusive; invalid/non-Unicode selection fails before product calls; resource witness selection preserves full normal inputs/assertions.

adopt: Represent statement target, projection/assignment/order/constraint roles explicitly; preserve source location and syntax options.
Use ordered repeated lists while keeping WHERE syntax separate from SELECT/DML clauses.
reject: Do not adopt general expressions in SET/projection/LIMIT/order terms, arbitrary aliases, WITH, RETURNING, UPDATE FROM/DELETE USING, OFFSET/FETCH, DISTINCT or broader DDL grammar.
Do not copy PostgreSQL memory contexts or raw list representation into the quota-accounted flat Rust arena.

adopt: Keep raw column/constraint syntax separate from catalog/name/type/constraint transformation.
reject: Do not reproduce namespace locks, utility-command expansion or serial rewrites in the pure parser.
PostgreSQL transformation timing does not establish XADB DDL precommit outcome semantics.

adopt: Preserve the raw type text/sign interval and explicit versus omitted sort/null placement.
Keep LIMIT a distinct clause and projection aliases as their own observed names.
reject: SQLite signed type syntax admits FLOAT and two numeric arguments; XADB type_length remains signed decimal digits only.
Reject implicit AS-less aliases, general expression projections/order/LIMIT, LIMIT OFFSET/comma forms and UPDATE/DELETE LIMIT in XADB.
Do not call schema/VDBE mutation actions from parser reductions.

adopt: Treat column limits/duplicate-name checks as separately identifiable semantic checks that need an explicit owner.
reject: Do not import sqlite3AddColumn early schema/limit/duplicate validation into XADB raw DDL parsing; XADB defers those semantic results until after DDL precommit.

decisions.ddl: Preserve raw signed type length; defer column/index count, duplicates, existence, PK nullability, encoded key/range checks until the future post-precommit semantic owner. Grammar cardinality/order and source/token/node/quota stay in parser.
decisions.limit: Unsigned decimal token or marker only; raw magnitude preserved; plus/minus Syntax; Int64 bound deferred.
decisions.order_alias: Raw simple Name accepted; parser cannot know alias versus an identically spelled input column; future binder looks up input columns only.
decisions.where: Reuse existing ParseInput::predicate with existing source, arena and statement-wide marker ordinal, without synthetic Predicate root.
decisions.contextual_words: Owner-directed proposal: preserve DISTINCT/ALL/IF/CHECK/FOREIGN/CONSTRAINT in valid Name roles; recognize only explicit bounded token shapes (SELECT modifier+body, CREATE IF NOT EXISTS, DROP IF EXISTS, CHECK+LP, FOREIGN+KEY, CONSTRAINT+Name), propagating speculative-peek lexical errors first. No keyword additions, token buffer, source copy, marker reset or AST ownership change.
